resource.title: Kraken2 database
resource.detail: Kraken2 needs a versioned taxonomic index in addition to its executable. Somite keeps this scientific resource outside the disposable Pixi environment.

resolutions.label: Use an existing database
resolutions.detail: Connect a Kraken2 database directory already present on this computer or mounted storage.

resolutions.label: Download Standard-8
resolutions.detail: The checksum-pinned June 2026 Standard collection capped at 8 GB for machines with limited disk and memory.
resolutions.scientific_effect: Smaller reference coverage than Standard, with much lower storage and memory requirements.

resolutions.label: Download Standard
resolutions.scientific_effect: Broader reference coverage than Standard-8, with substantially higher disk and memory requirements.

resolutions.label: Build a custom database
resolutions.detail: Choose the taxonomic libraries and build a project-specific Kraken2 index.
resolutions.scientific_effect: Reference coverage follows the selected libraries and build provenance.
